requirements.source_text: INV-01 | Every invoice belongs to a project/commercial engagement | Billing is Contract/Project-linked | ✅ | Preserve
INV-02 | Accounting needs the accepted commercial source before invoicing | BillingPlan comes from accepted commercial context | ✅ foundation | Preserve exact-source pinning
INV-03 | Contract is authority when one exists | Current Billing is contract-driven | ✅ | Preserve

INV-04 | If no Contract currently exists, accepted quotation can be operational reference | Current canonical Billing expects an eligible accepted Contract | 🔵 | Explicitly adjudicate quotation-fallback vs mandatory Contract
INV-05 | Owner intends future policy of a Contract for every project | Not yet a universally finalized Owner policy | 🔵 | Recommend making this canonical future rule
INV-06 | Exact client/company/person comes from accepted commercial source | Contract/client context exists | ✅ | Verify Invoice renderer uses pinned snapshot
INV-07 | Exact project name/reference comes from quotation/contract | Project/Contract context implemented | ✅ | Preserve lineage
INV-08 | Contract/project total comes from commercial source | Billing plan/informational total supported | ✅ | Render exactly
INV-09 | Payment schedule is copied exactly from quotation/contract | BillingMilestones exist | ✅ foundation | Confirm exact source version/pinning
INV-10 | Design, Supervision, Upload-Permit and Third-Party follow different billing patterns | Generic BillingPlan supports different schedules | 🟡 | Add explicit AMEC billing profiles
INV-11 | Design uses milestone/payment-schedule billing | Eligible BillingMilestones implemented | ✅ | Configure Owner profile
INV-12 | Supervision uses fixed recurring monthly invoices | Fixed milestones possible; automatic recurring monthly operating profile not proven | 🟡 | Add recurring Supervision schedule
INV-13 | Upload-Permit/consultant-only work can use special rates/form | No exact Owner profile proven | 🔴 | Define profile after commercial evidence
INV-14 | Third-Party engagements often have one/few payments | Generic plan supports it | ✅ foundation | Add profile convenience if useful
INV-15 | Standard invoice process is common across normal projects | Generic Invoice lifecycle exists | ✅ | Preserve
INV-16 | Office has one sequential invoice reference stream | Invoice reference allocation exists | ✅ foundation | Finalize production sequence policy

INV-18 | Sequence remains ordered through the year | Generic numbering exists | 🟡 | Confirm year-boundary/reset policy
INV-19 | Owner uses AMEC + year + sequence/reference format | Current test uses INV-AMEC-..., not yet Owner-approved final format | 🟡 | Configure exact production format
INV-20 | Invoice date = issue date | Implemented | ✅ | Preserve
INV-21 | Owner normally gives 5–7 days to pay | Due dates implemented | 🟡 | Make configurable default, not hardcoded universal law
INV-22 | Invoice can be addressed to company or individual | Party/client infrastructure exists | ✅ | Verify rendering
INV-23 | Invoice displays project name/reference | Context exists | ✅ | Exact template mapping

INV-33 | AMEC bank details appear on invoice | Governed FinancialAccount versions exist | ✅ foundation | Approve production account/version
INV-34 | Bank information is stable, not manually rewritten per invoice | FinancialAccount versioning solves this | ✅ | Preserve
INV-35 | Invoice requires AMEC signature/stamp before physical issue | Human control exists; exact signed artifact workflow partial | 🟡 | Capture signed/stamped final invoice artifact
INV-36 | Standard invoice format stays consistent across normal jobs | Exact official INV-Form.docx not yet promoted | 🟡 | Approve/promote governed Invoice Template
INV-37 | Accounting does not invent a milestone | Invoices require eligible BillingMilestones | ✅ | Protect
INV-38 | Exact %/amount follows quotation | BillingPlan/BillingMilestone supports this | ✅ foundation | Pin exact commercial revision

INV-43 | Design Manager/PM gives expected collection dates | No exact Owner workflow/provenance proven | 🟡 | Add authorized forecast update + actor/time history
INV-44 | Draft/Accept is separate from Issue | Explicitly implemented | ✅ | Preserve
INV-45 | Issued invoice is signed/stamped | Human Issue exists | 🟡 | Bind exact signed PDF/DocumentVersion
INV-46 | AMEC prints two original copies | Not a software action | ✅ operational boundary | Show as human task/checklist if useful
INV-47 | Courier gives one copy to client | Delivery event exists | ✅ foundation | Add COURIER/PHYSICAL channel
INV-48 | Client signs second copy acknowledging original receipt | Acknowledgment exists | ✅ foundation | Require scanned signed receipt evidence for physical process
INV-49 | Signed returned copy has same invoice reference | Canonical Invoice relation exists | 🟡 | Enforce evidence classification/reference

INV-52 | Receipt is evidentiary proof if client later disputes receipt | Immutable acknowledgment/evidence architecture exists | 🟡 | Exact artifact retention

INV-55 | Payment can arrive by bank transfer | Same | 🟡 | Same
INV-56 | Payment can arrive by cash | Same | 🟡 | Same

INV-60 | Human verifies payment | Explicitly implemented | ✅ | Preserve

INV-67 | Paid does not mean accounting/financial settlement | Explicitly protected | ✅ | Preserve
